premises.text: Breaches are inevitable so organizations must mitigate breach cost; encryption is the most effective measure
premises.evidence_span: it's no longer a question of whether a breach will occur, but rather what the cost of this breach will be

premises.text: Calypso keeps cloud database data encrypted at rest, in transit, and in memory while still allowing search
premises.evidence_span: the data remains encrypted, addressed, in transit, and in memory at the database storage

premises.text: Data decrypts only in the application; the key is never revealed and no application changes are required
premises.evidence_span: The key never gets revealed, and no application changes are required

premises.text: A Docker interceptor encrypts the stream in real time and supports SQL analytics on ciphertext with dynamic re-encryption
premises.evidence_span: Our Docker intercepts the data stream and encrypts the data in real time before storing it

premises.text: Oblivious RAM plus differential privacy yields efficient secure indexing beyond prior encrypted-DB tradeoffs
premises.evidence_span: we combine cryptography, so oblivious RAM, with differential privacy in order to ensure an efficient and secure indexing of these records

premises.text: Go-to-market targets financial services, cloud-native firms, and database providers as channel partners
premises.evidence_span: working with direct engagements with financial services, medium-sized, cloud-native companies, and also database providers as channel partners

value.text: True cloud-database security with usable private search and analytics
value.evidence_span: first never decrypt cloud database solution

causal_links.evidence_span: Encryption is the most effective measure in mitigating this risk
private search engine on top of encrypted data
